title: Klammerdiagramm — tribhuvanam (samāhāra-dvigu)
desc: Leitan's samāhāra-dvigu example tribhuvanam (trayāṇāṃ bhuvanānāṃ samāhāraḥ — the three worlds as a collective): dvigu = an ordinary right-to-left directed pair, numeral first; his three Pāṇinian conditions are classification, not structure (MG vote D1). I/II часть omitted (notation demo).
